name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover the cost of flooded room cleanup?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover the cost of flooded room cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowner's insurance policies often cover sudden and accidental water damage, such as a burst pipe or overflowing appliance. However, coverage for flood damage, which is typically defined as water entering from the outside (e.g., rising rivers, heavy rain), usually requires a separate flood insurance policy. It is crucial to review your specific policy details or contact your insurance provider directly to understand what is covered. A professional restoration company can assist with documenting the damage for your claim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coverage depends on your policy and the cause of flooding. Homeowner's insurance may cover sudden water damage, but flood damage often requires a separate flood insurance policy. Check with your provider.
